blocking_findings.title: Finding-384 controls and their fixture edit are absent from the reviewed HEAD
blocking_findings.where: HEAD b03633329: review-affa17.md finding 384; README 'ext4 reference run k and IR-ML3-04 prerequisites'; commit message; evidence/affa17/lane-admission-20261020b/ (committed) versus tests/thesis_lite/maestro/test_runtime_lane_admission.py and test_affa_release_timeout_fence.py (untracked) and test_runtime_entry.py ENVIRONMENT_DIGEST (uncommitted)
blocking_findings.why_blocking: The committed record reports '23 passed per phase' and IR-ML3-04 control evidence over source files that the commit does not contain; lane-b binds their hashes (c7804730…43ca, f33d4394…0570, 603361be…8e8e) but retains no copy of the bytes, so a reader of HEAD cannot inspect or reproduce the cited controls. An acceptance decision taken on this snapshot would rest on evidence whose producing controls are outside the configuration baseline. The commit message discloses the deferral, which keeps the record honest but does not remove the gap.
blocking_findings.recommendation: Make the fourth checkpoint commit after run l with the three files at exactly the quoted hashes (or record any change with its own finding and a lane re-run); until then, mark finding 384's evidence in README and the register as 'controls pending commit'. Consider retaining module bytes alongside future bounded-evidence directories.

blocking_findings.title: F-01 owned control does not assert the release-timeout discriminators it is credited with
blocking_findings.where: tests/thesis_lite/maestro/test_affa_release_timeout_fence.py (working tree, f33d4394…0570) lines 53, 69-71; review-affa17.md findings 382(a) and 384(b); README sentence 'dispositioned as documented Python-side preconditions with owned controls'
blocking_findings.why_blocking: The test asserts only that the reply kind is REJECTED, that the cleanup-only fence released the boundary and that no marker exists. It does not assert reply.reason, the elapsed time against the 2 s ticket, or a non-empty residual membership before the fence, which are the facts finding 384(b) reports and the only facts that distinguish the F-01 path (run_authority.c:358 wait until g->deadline, then close_authority with an elapsed end so freeze_all at 161 skips the refreeze, then REJECTED with the generic PROTOCOL reason 4) from an immediate protocol rejection. The retained receipts (reply_reason 4, reply_seconds 2.0, members_before_fence [pid]) do support the finding's observation, but the control as written would pass without exercising F-01, so the finding-382 disposition 'documented Python-side precondition proven by an owned test' is not yet proven by the test itself.
blocking_findings.recommendation: Add assertions on reply.reason == 4 (PROTOCOL) together with reply_seconds >= the ticket minus a small tolerance, on members_before_fence being non-empty (pre-exec child still a member), and on marker_before_fence false; re-run verify-lane-admission (new evidence directory, new receipt); only then bind the control to ML-CAPA-381-F01 in the next CAPA successor. If a timeout-specific reason code is wanted natively, that belongs to the queued helper change with new frozen hashes and a fresh review.

blocking_findings.title: capa.md attributes the F-01/F-02 disposition to the author although it is an agent proposal pending author decision
blocking_findings.where: docs/engineering/maestro-lite/capa.md, run-k successor paragraph: '… ML-CAPA-381-F01 and ML-CAPA-381-F02 (independent review observations on run_authority.c, UNRESOLVED, author disposition recorded as documented Python-side preconditions with owned controls, finding382)'
blocking_findings.why_blocking: The register (authoritative) records both corrections as 'none_pending_author_disposition'; finding 382 labels the dispositions as agent proposals under the author's 'propose something and go'; the thesis tasks.md states 'Author decisions pending: disposition of the two MEDIUM observations'; the uncommitted finding 385 does not name them. The CAPA narrative therefore overclaims authority provenance on two UNRESOLVED records that back the IR-ML3-04 prerequisite statement; an acceptance reader could take the MEDIUM observations as author-dispositioned.
blocking_findings.recommendation: Reword to 'agent-proposed disposition (finding 382), pending explicit author confirmation', align the README sentence ('dispositioned …') the same way, and bind the author's confirmation record in the next successor when it is given.
